content_blocks.text: The PLA is delighted to announce the establishment of a new working group to consider the application of procurement law to development agreements and development joint ventures particularly in light of the judgment by the Court of Appeal in Faraday Development Ltd v West Berkshire Council [2018] EWCA Civ 2532 . The working group will commence New Year 2019. For further information, please see the following https://www.procurementlawyers.org.uk/working-groups/current-projects/
